notes: Διὰ τοῦτο → Therefore is one noncompositional unit headed on the governed demonstrative (rule 45).

ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ → a certain king gives unto a certain to the first noun; reading the supplied determiner and preposition onto βασιλεῖ under rule 58's reasoning, with a bare certain left to ἀνθρώπῳ, remains defensible.
συνᾶραι λόγον splits because the ASV spells both members of the pair out (rules 2, 73).
